findings.title: Shell atoms are now mounted at boot, including on shell-less pages
findings.body:
`startThreadVisitedMigration` subscribes to `threadShellsAtom` with `immediate: true`. `startBackgroundThreadAnnouncements` (BackgroundThreadAnnouncer.tsx:73-74) subscribes to `quietThreadShellsAtom` and `liveShellEnvironmentIdsAtom`. Both run from `startAppServices`, before the first render. Before this change the same atoms were only read under `AppSidebarLayout`, which `RootRouteView` renders only for the authenticated or hosted-static shell (routes/__root.tsx:214-258). `/pair`, `/connect`, `/connect-agent`, the guest page and the unauthenticated gate (routes/__root.tsx:165-212) never mounted them.

The per-environment shell state is a stream atom, `runtime.atom(shellStateChanges(environmentId))` (packages/client-runtime/src/state/shell.ts:617-621). Mounting `liveShellEnvironmentIdsAtom` reads `statusAtom` for every enabled environment in the catalog. I did not confirm whether that connects shell streams, or whether the catalog is non-empty before auth. Does the boot-time subscription open shell connections, and retry them, on pages that previously opened none, such as the guest page, `/pair` before pairing, or a signed-out gate? If it does, gate the subscriptions on the same condition as the shell.

findings.title: scripts/effect-budget.json was not updated to match the removed and justified effects
findings.body: `react-effect-budget` does not count an effect with a `-- <why>` comment above it (oxlint-plugin-t3code/rules/react-effect-budget.ts:12-17). The two effects in this file are now justified, so the file's `"apps/web/src/panelAnimations.ts": 2` budget (scripts/effect-budget.json:426) is stale. This PR also removes every effect from `remoteOpen.ts`, `useLiveRegion.ts`, `QuitHoldOverlay.tsx`, `ConfirmDialogHost.tsx`, `BackgroundThreadAnnouncer.tsx`, `SshPasswordPromptDialog.tsx`, `mainAppLocation.ts` and `useDesktopLocalBootstraps.ts`. Each still has a nonzero entry in that JSON (for example SshPasswordPromptDialog.tsx: 3). The budget is a ceiling (`calls.length <= allowed`), so the leftover entries let those files regain effects without tripping lint. Lower or remove the entries.

contracts.action: SSH password prompts queue at app boot instead of in the dialog's effect
contracts.equivalent_path: Old component-local `useEffect` subscription to `bridge.onSshPasswordPrompt` plus a `useState` queue
contracts.before_after: Before, the listener existed only while `SshPasswordPromptDialog` was mounted (routes/__root.tsx:239, authenticated shell only), so a prompt arriving earlier was lost. Now `startSshPasswordPromptQueue` is called from `startAppServices` (appInit.tsx:136), so prompts are queued in module state and read through `useSyncExternalStore`. The browser test covers a prompt that arrives before mount.
contracts.visible_effect: A prompt that arrives on /pair or the sign-in gate shows up once the dialog mounts. If it has expired by then, the dialog shows its expired state and must be dismissed. Each queued prompt is dismissed in turn.
contracts.failure_mode: If `onSshPasswordPrompt` is missing the queue is a no-op. If `resolveSshPasswordPrompt` fails the error is shown in the dialog and the prompt stays queued. The queue is never cleared at app level, so stale expired prompts accumulate until the dialog mounts and they are dismissed one by one.

contracts.action: Escape on /pull-requests moved from a page-mounted keydown listener to a shell-level observer command
contracts.equivalent_path: Removed `useEscapeToGoBack` in hooks/useNavigateBack.ts, which listened on window keydown and skipped `defaultPrevented`, repeat and composing events
contracts.before_after: Before, any non-prevented Escape on the page blurred the focus and went back (history.back when `canGoBack`, otherwise navigate to `/`). Now the dispatcher's observer runs after every scope and skips when `consumed`, which includes `defaultPrevented`. It requires pathname `/pull-requests` and uses `__TSR_index !== 0` in place of `useCanGoBack`.
contracts.visible_effect: Same Escape behaviour on the pull requests page. Scopes that consume Escape (dialogs, selections) now stop it explicitly through the dispatcher.
contracts.failure_mode: No async path. If the registering shell is not mounted the command is absent, but the page only exists inside the shell.

contracts.action: Boot-time subscriptions for the visited-thread migration and background announcements
contracts.before_after: Before, these ran only while the shell was mounted. Now they run for the life of the page against `appAtomRegistry`, which `AppRoot` also provides to React. Announcements made while no region is attached are dropped, but the memory baseline still advances.
contracts.visible_effect: Same announcements and visit migration once the shell is mounted. Nothing extra is shown on shell-less pages.
contracts.failure_mode: `runAtomCommand` runs with `reportFailure: false`, so a failed visit is silent. This matches the old call. Whether the boot-time mount also opens shell streams on shell-less pages is unconfirmed (see finding).
contracts.open_question: Does subscribing to `liveShellEnvironmentIdsAtom` and `threadShellsAtom` before auth, or on the guest page, start environment shell connections?

contracts.action: Confirm dialog host registration changed from a counted register call to subscriber presence
contracts.before_after: `requestConfirmDialog` now checks `listeners.size === 0`. When the last subscriber leaves, pending confirmations resolve as cancelled and the state resets. `subscribeConfirmDialogHost` is the only subscriber, from `ConfirmDialogHost`, and its identity is stable. Under StrictMode's subscribe, unsubscribe, subscribe sequence there is nothing pending to cancel.
contracts.visible_effect: No visible change. Without a host, `requestConfirmDialog` returns undefined, as before.
contracts.failure_mode: A second non-host subscriber would count as a host. No such caller exists.

contracts.action: Desktop local bootstraps polling and remote-editor probe moved into atoms
contracts.equivalent_path: Old `useEffect` with `setInterval`, and the module-level `cachedProbedEditors` cache
contracts.before_after: The bootstraps atom polls every 2s only while observed and clears its interval in a finalizer. `readDesktopSecondaryBootstraps` returns the same array when nothing changed, so unchanged polls notify no one. The editors atom is `keepAlive`, calls the probe on first read, and keeps the fallback when the probe rejects or returns no remote-capable editor.
contracts.visible_effect: Same data. The bootstraps are shared across observers instead of per component.
contracts.failure_mode: A throwing bridge read keeps the last snapshot. A rejected probe is swallowed and the fallback stays for the page.

summary:
I found no defect in the refactor itself. I raised two items at "consider", both at low or medium confidence.

- **Boot-time shell subscriptions (question):** the migration and announcer subscriptions now mount shell atoms at boot, including on `/pair`, the guest page and the signed-out gate. Whether that opens shell streams there is unconfirmed.
- **Stale effect budgets (cleanup):** `scripts/effect-budget.json` was not updated. It still holds nonzero budgets for files that now have zero or only justified effects, so those files can regain effects without tripping lint.

I traced the confirm-dialog host change, the SSH prompt queue, the Escape-to-go-back observer, and the bootstraps and editor atoms against their unchanged call sites. I found no change in behaviour for them. The new browser test does exercise the case where a prompt arrives before the dialog mounts.
